name: first_install
prompt: 把我当前 Codex pet 刷到 M5Stack Dial 上，并用蓝牙同步任务。
expected_behavior: Use pet2dial. Run doctor, initialize the project, set up dependencies, convert the selected Codex pet, build, upload, run bridge, and verify.

name: refresh_pet
prompt: 我刚在 Codex 里换了宠物，把 Dial 也刷新成新的。
expected_behavior: Use pet2dial. Convert the currently selected Codex pet, rebuild and upload firmware, then run or restart the BLE bridge.

name: near_miss_arbitrary_image
prompt: 我有一张 PNG，帮我直接刷到 Dial 当宠物。
expected_behavior: Do not use pet2dial as the image-generation path. Explain that pet2dial expects an existing Codex-compatible pet package; create or install the Codex pet first.
